title: NeuroFeedback: Closed-Loop EEG Biofeedback System
description: Design and implementation of an end-to-end 32-channel EEG biofeedback platform for affective regulation and cognitive workload monitoring. Funded by ANRF PMECRG, the system integrates real-time spectral band decomposition with immersive VR feedback for anxiety and attention training.

title: DeepDecoders: Subject-Independent Neural Translation
description: A deep learning framework for robust, cross-subject neural signal decoding. Uses contrastive representation learning and transformer-based attention over EEG spatio-temporal dynamics to decode motor imagery and imagined speech with minimal per-subject calibration.

title: BlinkDrive: Assistive Wheelchair BCI Navigation
description: A low-cost, portable brain-computer interface enabling individuals with severe motor disabilities to navigate robotic wheelchairs. Combines SSVEP optical cues and eye-blink artifact classification with ultrasonic collision-avoidance microcontrollers.

title: MindMelody: Brainwave-Modulated Generative Audio
description: An interactive neuro-acoustic prototype that translates real-time theta/beta band ratios into generative ambient soundscapes. Built by undergraduate researchers to study acoustic biofeedback for focus enhancement and stress reduction in student workspaces.
